name: Tofino
tagline: Surf, rainforest and winter storms on the Pacific
summary: Tofino is a small surf town at the edge of Vancouver Island's wild west coast. Surf Long Beach and Chesterman, walk boardwalks through giant cedar rainforest in Pacific Rim National Park, watch whales and bears by boat and come in winter to watch huge Pacific storms roll in.
seasonNote: Summer is mild and busy; November to February is storm-watching season.
arrival: About 4.5 hours by car and ferry from Vancouver, or a short flight.
gettingAround: Car or bike; a free summer shuttle runs between beaches.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 15 to 20 percent.
foodTip: Fish tacos, Dungeness crab and local oysters.
buyTip: Indigenous art from the Roy Henry Vickers gallery.

connections.note: Ferry to Nanaimo then a winding drive.

coverWiki: Long Beach, Pacific Rim National Park
